name: isFreeOfConnectWiseAppExposure
definition: True when the tenant's full service-principal list was read and neither ConnectWise Cloud Backup (506e08f9-6e9a-4da4-942b-a099a03644ae) nor ConnectWise Cloud Management - MS Teams (24205314-2b89-4e07-a2a4-579e898a5640) has an enabled service principal in it.
population: service principals in one Microsoft Entra tenant whose appId is one of the two ConnectWise multitenant apps named in the October 2026 advisory
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete, unpaged, error-free servicePrincipals read filtered by the two appIds that returns no enabled record for either app.

changeLog.change: Registered with the ConnectWise OAuth app exposure transform; proposed, no requirement reads it yet.

notes: Threat-specific (ConnectWise multitenant OAuth app abuse, Microsoft Threat Intelligence and Huntress, 16-17 Oct 2026). An empty filtered list is the measured answer 'neither app is present', so emptyPopulationMeans is compliant; a refused, errored or paged read is Not evaluated. A present but disabled service principal cannot obtain tokens and reads true. allowedCategories is empty until Integration-Service maps an RTA row; the intended home is Azure AD (One-Click).
